svg.title: Type markdown and math; it renders in place
svg.desc: In a notes page a display equation is typed as LaTeX with a live preview floating above it and renders in place when the caret leaves; a callout is typed as markdown and becomes a boxed note; a pasted figure is widened by dragging its edge grip, which writes the width into the image link.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Notes that render as you type
Markdown, LaTeX, callouts and pictures — the block you are on stays raw, the rest renders.
